answer: Enforced work-uniqueness resists sybils: every challenge answer must hash distinctly, so a fake cannot clone one good response across a trellis of accounts — duplicates are rejected in replay like a cracked relic. Each identity must produce ORIGINAL work per epoch, and the violet thread tying each answer to its unpredictable seed means precomputed or copied text fails the machine check before any human judges it. Scale buys no shortcut when every seat owes its own distinct labor.
